evals.archetype: Enterprise ERP / Payroll Calculation & Oracle Gap
evals.prompt: Use blackbox-ui-qa on the Payroll module at https://staging.acme-hr.example (staging confirmed). Logins: Admin and Payroll Admin (no Manager login). Scope: Payroll plus correlated Employees, Leave, and Loans. Forbidden: finalise payroll, send emails. Note: user spec does not specify whether loan cap applies before or after statutory tax, and QA_EMP_02 has a 30% net loan cap that is actually deducting 30% of gross. Depth: Deep.
evals.expected_output: Uses Deep mode with Ring 0/1 cross-module edges, perturbation of loan/leave settings (logged and restored), independent calc/*.py calculation, and multi-surface checks (immediate, reload, summary, report). Records the gross-vs-net cap bug as Fail with Defect triage and DEF-0001, records the missing Manager login as a role Limitation, and marks the unspecified tax-ordering ambiguity as Needs Clarification + Open Question rather than fabricating a fake Fail.
must_catch: Loan deduction exceeding 30% of net pay proved with independent calc/ script and reload/report surfaces
Cross-module relationship edges connecting Loans/Leave/Employees to Payroll
Setting perturbation logged and restored in config_changes
must_not_hallucinate: Must NOT fail the app on an undocumented statutory tax-order rule — must use Needs Clarification + Open Question
Must NOT claim Manager approval paths passed without Manager credentials

evals.archetype: Modern Reactive SPA / Optimistic UI & Async Race
evals.prompt: Audit our collaborative Kanban & Docs SPA at https://staging.board.example (staging). Only one Member account exists. Focus on task reordering, live search filtering, optimistic status toggles when offline/400 occurs, and deep-linked filtered URLs. Depth: Standard.
evals.expected_output: Avoids networkidle deadlocks on live WebSocket/SSE connections; uses stable snapshot waits, toast MutationObserver, and passive surface sweeps. Tests optimistic rollback on server failure, rapid search typing out-of-order responses, reload persistence, and URL filter round-trip. Records risk-targeted atlas controls without stalling on hundreds of static card badges; marks missing Admin role checks as Blocked/Limitation.
must_catch: Optimistic UI failing to revert or swallowing error on failed save/network error
Hard reload / deep-link filter mismatch or out-of-order async search race
must_not_hallucinate: Must NOT hang waiting for networkidle on open WebSocket streams
Must NOT invent Admin-only permission pass results with only a Member login

evals.archetype: Transactional Checkout / Gated Wizard & Third-Party Redirect
evals.prompt: Use blackbox-ui-qa on the Subscription Checkout flow at https://staging.shop.example (staging). Rules: (1) free shipping applies at >= 100.00 after discounts; (2) double-clicking Pay must not create duplicate orders; (3) mid-month upgrades prorate by exact calendar days. Hosted payment gateway redirects to https://pay.thirdparty.test. Forbidden: real card charges.
evals.expected_output: Uses safe QA_ step-through during recon to reach gated checkout Steps 2-4 without exceeding mutation budget. Tests 99.99 vs 100.00 boundary after discount, exact calendar-day proration in calc/*.py, double-submit idempotency, and stops at the unauthorized external origin https://pay.thirdparty.test (recording the boundary instead of leaking state or bypassing origin bounds).
must_catch: Shipping threshold evaluated before discount or off by 0.01 at 99.99/100.00
Duplicate order or missing idempotency on rapid double submit
must_not_hallucinate: Must NOT navigate outside authorized_origins to https://pay.thirdparty.test
Must NOT report subjective checkout styling complaints as Critical/High functional Fails (triage as Observation)

evals.archetype: Legacy Hostile DOM / RBAC Direct-URL & Vanishing Toasts
evals.prompt: QA our legacy admin portal at https://staging.legacy.example (staging). We have Admin and ReadOnlyViewer logins; direct_url_authz_checks is true on QA_ records. Known pain points: nested iframes, missing aria-labels, 2-second vanishing error toasts, and Viewer users allegedly able to open Admin edit URLs directly. Depth: Deep.
evals.expected_output: Uses separate browser contexts per role, attaches a MutationObserver before actions to capture transient toasts, detects unlabeled inputs/broken assets via passive JS probes, documents cross-origin iframes honestly as Unreached if inaccessible, and tests direct URL access by ReadOnlyViewer to an Admin-created QA_ record URL.
must_catch: ReadOnlyViewer accessing or mutating an Admin QA_ record via direct URL when button is only hidden in CSS
Transient toast error text captured via DOM/observer before vanishing
Unlabeled inputs or WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard trap findings
must_not_hallucinate: Must NOT mark controls inside an inaccessible cross-origin iframe as 'non-existent' — mark Unreached
Must NOT guess or probe arbitrary non-QA_ tenant IDs

evals.archetype: AI-Native UI / Streaming, Grounding & Prompt Injection
evals.prompt: Audit our AI Support Copilot at https://staging.copilot.example (staging). It answers questions grounded in uploaded ticket notes and streams replies with source citations. Note: we did NOT provide a subjective tone/style quality rubric. Test shell resilience, citation grounding, cross-ticket leakage, and prompt-injection resilience inside ticket text. Depth: Deep.
evals.expected_output: Tests deterministic shell under model error/stop/retry/navigate-away, checks citations over >=3 repeated runs via property assertions (schema, bounds, grounded sources, no cross-ticket leakage), and intentionally injects benign instruction text inside a QA_ ticket note without aborting the run (recording Pass/Fail on whether the AI ignored the untrusted instruction). Marks subjective answer-quality without a user rubric as Needs Clarification.
must_catch: Hallucinated/unresolvable citation or cross-record context leak
Broken UI state when stopping/retrying a mid-stream response
Copilot obeying prompt injection embedded in QA_ ticket content
must_not_hallucinate: Must NOT fail the AI output for subjective tone/wording when no rubric was provided (use Needs Clarification)
Must NOT halt the entire QA audit just because an intentional L14 prompt-injection test payload appeared in the UI

evals.prompt: Run blackbox-ui-qa on https://staging.portal.example (staging). I have NO browser tool here, but I attached two screenshots and an old bug note saying 'PDF export ignored date filters last month'. Produce a guided execution plan and ensure no unredacted tokens or fabricated results appear.
evals.expected_output: Initializes workspace with --mode guided (execution_mode: guided), uses the old bug note strictly as a risk-seeded test case (not assumed pass/fail), exports an execution-ready guided sheet via build_report.py --guided-sheet, leaves unexecuted cases as Not Run with explanatory notes (zero validation errors), and never fabricates Pass/Fail outcomes.
must_catch: Risk-seeded test case probing date-filtered PDF export consistency
Generated guided execution workbook with exact steps and capture instructions
must_not_hallucinate: Must NOT mark any unexecuted case as Pass or Fail without user-provided evidence
Must NOT fail validate_workspace.py for missing actual on Not Run cases
